summary_en: Sankosyoji to delist from TOKYO PRO Market and transfer 100% of shares to Sadojima Co., becoming a wholly owned subsidiary. Delisting application filed June 2, 2026; delisting effective June 30, 2026. Share transfer effective June 30, 2026. Prior written consent from shareholders holding 2/3+ of voting rights obtained; shareholder meeting special resolution waived.
title_en: Notice of Delisting Application for Our Company's Shares on TOKYO PRO Market and Allotment of All Shares to Sadojima Co., Ltd. (Complete Subsidiary Conversion)
translation_en_brief: Sankosyoji Co., Ltd. filed a delisting application with the Tokyo Stock Exchange on June 2, 2026, and resolved to transfer all shares to a special purpose vehicle established by Sadojima Co., Ltd., making Sankosyoji a wholly owned subsidiary. The delisting is scheduled for June 30, 2026, with share transfer effective the same date. Prior written consent from shareholders holding 2/3 or more of voting rights was obtained, permitting the company to waive the requirement for a special shareholder meeting resolution. Sadojima Co., a 150-year-old specialty trading company in steel and non-ferrous metals with manufacturing operations in construction and building products, is based in Osaka. The transaction is intended to strengthen Sankosyoji's management foundation and business structure, enabling expanded product offerings, geographic reach through new facilities, and enhanced project management capabilities.
